labels.text: section 1402(j)(2)(B): in applying paragraph (2) of subsection (b) to church employee income, "$100" shall be substituted for "$400" — unindexed statutory amount; the 1990-01-01 start date is the church-employee-income regime's general effective date (section 1402(j) added by the Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1989, applicable to remuneration paid after 1983 for tax purposes generally effective from 1990 collection years) and is NOT independently verified against a pinned amendment note in this package's own sources.law — flagged, see coverage note
